messages:
Ava_finance: Heads up: we're scheduling a small pricing experiment for the embeddings pricebook. Target go-live 2026-04-05 08:00 UTC. Changes: slight per-embedding rate change + adjusted tier credits for mid-size dev teams. Need a short ops runbook covering invoice preview, grandfathering rules, and exceptions.

miguel_billing: Can we narrow the cohort? I need to know exact selection criteria (plan IDs, tags). Also need approval to add `applied_rate_id` to invoice lines to make audits easier.

priya_sales: We must exclude any customers with negotiated terms. I'll attach the list of flagged contracts. No surprise charges for them.

sophie_legal: Agreed. Exclude customers marked `enterprise` or with `custom_pricing=true`. I'll circulate approved comms wording with explicit "no retroactive billing" language.

tom_platform: I'll prepare a staging query and run a dry migration. Staging SQL to validate cohort:
```sql
SELECT s.id, s.customer_id, s.plan_id, c.tags, s.next_billing_date
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.next_billing_date BETWEEN '2026-04-05' AND '2026-05-03'
  AND c.tags NOT LIKE '%enterprise%';
```
Run in staging first and share CSV.

miguel_billing: Will run in staging tomorrow and push CSV to /finance-drive. Also running invoice-preview tool: `./bin/invoice-preview --cohort embeddings-pricebook-expt --samples 100`

Ava_finance: Canary schedule proposed: 5% of invoice volume first 24h, then 25% for days 2-4, full at day 7 if no regressions. Rollback triggers: >5% revenue variance in 24h, >1pt NPS drop on billing survey, or >0.5% increase in billing tickets.

priya_sales: I'll reach out to AMs for any accounts in the live cohort. @sophie_legal can you sign off on comms by Fri EOD? We want to send heads-up emails 48hrs before go-live.

sophie_legal: Yes. I'll post the comms template by Fri noon. Will include opt-out and support escalation language.

billing-bot: billing-bot: invoice-preview run complete for cohort embeddings-pricebook-expt. 100 samples uploaded: https://redir.company/samples/embeddings-pricebook-preview.csv

miguel_billing: CSV shows 8 subscriptions with manual rate overrides. Proposal: mark them `manual-grandfather` and issue one-time credits when needed. Need sign-off on credit calc method.

Ava_finance: OK to use one-time credits for manual overrides. Miguel, prepare an exceptions sheet with proposed credit amounts and rationale for each. We'll review in the preflight call.

tom_platform: NOTE: the rate routing table needs an entry mapping `embeddings_pricebook` -> `RATECARD_EMBED_V2`. I'll open a PR against payments-service and include runbook steps. Also will run the migration in dry-run mode: `make billing-migrate COHORT=embeddings-pricebook-expt DRY_RUN=1`

priya_sales: Timeline check: Miguel run staging query by 2026-03-28, Sophie approve comms by 2026-03-27 EOD, Tom open PR & dry-run by 2026-03-29. Final preflight 2026-04-02. Go/no-go call 2026-04-04.

Ava_finance: Action list noted. Miguel add exceptions + credit plan, Sophie post legal copy, Tom link PR and dry-run logs, Priya coordinate AM outreach. We'll use 5% canary 2026-04-05 08:00 UTC if all green.

priya_sales: Thanks all — will ping again once cohort CSV is posted. :white_check_mark:
